crossRefs.note: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.
Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out…
But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness…
Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in…
He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.
My God, turn your ear, and hear. Open your eyes, and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name…
But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God…
May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,
Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water…

translations.web: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
translations.bsb: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.
translations.kjv: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
translations.asv: Deal with thy servant according unto thy lovingkindness, And teach me thy statutes.
